newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 12 bln Skr T-bill auction cut down.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 12 bln Skr T-bill auction cut down.

text.p: An auction of Swedish Treasury bills worth 12 billion crowns was reduced to nine billion crowns, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month T-bills was 4.11 percent, the office said.
The office had invited bids for a total 2.0 billion crowns and received 26 bids worth 4.74 billion crowns of which it accepted six.
An auction of six month T-bills valued at 3.0 billion crowns was also oversubscribed and the average accepted rate was 4.31 percent.
The office received 39 bids worth 3.56 billion crowns and accepted 36.
The office said the average accepted rate in an auction of 12 month T-bills worth 3.9 billion crowns was 4.65 percent. The office had earlier said the auction would be for seven billion crowns.
It received 40 bids worth 4.0 billion crowns and accepted 39 bids.
